summary: Diameter Credit Company filed an 8-K reporting a $412.6 million term debt securitization (CLO) by its subsidiary CLO Issuer. The transaction involves issuance of secured notes (Classes A-1, A-2, B) and subordinated notes, plus Class A-1 loans, all secured by loan collateral. This is a routine financing transaction, not a special situation. The filing describes standard CLO mechanics: notes bear interest at SOFR plus spreads, and the subsidiary incurs debt. There is no change of control, no shareholder vote, no premium or tender. What to watch: credit quality of underlying collateral; no risk-arb angle.
